a.text: I take my most fragile memories and wrap them up tight, until not a soul is left who knows.

spans.text: I take my most fragile memories and wrap them up tight, until not a soul is left who knows.

a.text: But even as I shout until my voice is raw, is there any hope of making her hear me?

spans.text: But even as I shout until my voice is raw, is there any hope of making her hear me?

steps.text: After enduring the rocking of the boat, stepping onto solid ground finally brings Sakiko a sense of reassurance.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Boatman
steps.text: 'Preciate you chatting with me, young miss.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Boatman
steps.text: This island's one hell of a trip from the mainland. Why, if I only had the surface of the water for company, I'd go mad from boredom.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: It was a pleasure to talk to you. I rather enjoyed hearing your tales of the sea.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Boatman
steps.text: Reminds me, you don't dress like a local. What brings you to this podunk little island?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...I'm looking for someone.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Boatman
steps.text: She a local?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I don't... imagine so.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Boatman
steps.text: That's mighty strange then. This island's all people who wanna get off it. Never heard of anyone wanting to come over.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: To be honest, I'm not entirely sure if she's here or not...
All she has in hand is a ticket to the island. Even if it does turn out to be a prank on Morpheus's part, she has no other choice.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Boatman
steps.text: (Pats her shoulder) Ah, it'll be fine! With this few people on the island, you'll be done asking if anyone's seen her in no time!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Boatman
steps.text: But one thing. Doesn't matter if you find her or not, you have to be back here by noon.

spans.text: But one thing. Doesn't matter if you find her or not, you
to be back here by noon.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Boatman
steps.text: Not many boats come this way. If you miss this one when it leaves, you'll be stuck until next month.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: But it's nearly...

steps.name: Enthusiastic Boatman
steps.text: *sigh* Sorry, not much I can do.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Boatman
steps.text: I can wait for you some, but it's not safe on the seas at night. We need to be back on the mainland before sundown.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...Right, I'll be going now then!
(Loudly) Do—re—mi—
Yes, I can hear you.
(Quietly) Do—re—mi—
I just went through it again, further away... Were you unable to hear it?
Yes... I didn't hear anything just now.
...Let me get that blindfold off of you first.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: How are my results?

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: I hate to say this, but... compared to last time, it seems like the range I can hear has gotten even smaller.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: I see... Okay, I understand. I'll be more aware of environmental conditions on my future surveys.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Eyjafjalla, you should cherish your personal safety more.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: How long have you been on the island?

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: I arrived two months ago.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Your hearing is getting worse, but we don't have a formal doctor here who can help you.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: There should be a boat at the dock today. I'll pack your luggage for you, and then you can set off for home.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: I can't. I still have one last round of data to collect from the volcano here...

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: But your health—

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Before I came here, I had a doctor at Rhodes Island give me a health assessment.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Umm... While my situation isn't very optimistic, I did promise her I would be back within three months.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: She knows how important my volcanological research is to me, so she agreed to me coming here in the end.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: I love volcanos, Miss Uika, just as much as you love the stars.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Wasn't the very first time we met up on the mountain, that night when I got lost, and stumbled upon you watching the stars?

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: ...Next time you head up there to survey, remember to call me along.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Yes, of course!

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: The weather's so fine this morning...

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Miss Uika, could you sing a song to me?

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Some music would go perfectly with weather like this, while we gaze out at the volcano and the sea far away.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Alright. I'll come in a little closer...
Uika narrows the gap between the two of them. She sees Eyjafjalla's little ears perk up, the hearing aids visible inside.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: (Deep breath)

a.text: 'As I paint the twisted sky, I think,'
'I wish you'd, without wings, just fall,'

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: That was beautiful!

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: ...Thanks.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Who wrote this song? I don't think I've heard it elsewhere. Is it a local song?

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: I don't know either. It's probably just something I heard before, and it just stuck in my memory...

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: But, Miss Uika... You look so sad right now.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Puzzled Islander
steps.text: Hm? Uika Misumi?

steps.name: Puzzled Islander
steps.text: John, you ever hear of that name?

steps.name: Another Puzzled Islander
steps.text: Don't recall. Sounds like someone not from the island.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Could I trouble you to keep thinking over it, sir?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I heard from an old woman nearby that you're the most social person on this island, and that you know more people than anyone else. I'm sure something you know could serve as a lead...

steps.name: Puzzled Islander
steps.text: *sigh*... Not many people on the island, though. If none of us at all have heard the name, it must be a newcomer, right?

steps.name: Puzzled Islander
steps.text: Hey, wait, wasn't there talk about some weirdo living in a villa on the volcano's back side?

steps.name: Another Puzzled Islander
steps.text: Hmm... I think there was someone there, yeah.

steps.name: Another Puzzled Islander
steps.text: Can't quite remember her name, but I wanna say she's the only one you could be looking for.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Where is she right now?!

steps.name: No-Longer-Puzzled Islander
steps.text: Well, follow the road circling the island north for twenty kilometers. Once you reach the back of the mountain, you'll see the villa.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Alright. Twenty kilometers, that should be about half an hour by car...

steps.name: No-Longer-Puzzled Islander
steps.text: Oh, we don't have cars here.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You don't have cars?!

steps.name: Another No-Longer-Puzzled Islander
steps.text: Didn't you realize when you came here? We don't have cars.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: But the roads are clearly well-maintained...

steps.name: No-Longer-Puzzled Islander
steps.text: We wanted to attract tourists to the island. We fixed everything up... and nobody came. We just ended up even more broke.

steps.name: No-Longer-Puzzled Islander
steps.text: If you're in a hurry, missy, borrow this here bike.

steps.name: No-Longer-Puzzled Islander
steps.text: It's not in the prettiest shape, but there's some use in it still. If you pedal hard, you should make it in about two hours.
Sakiko looks at the old bicycle behind the old man. Its frame is shabby and worn-out, nearly denuded of paint. Everything about it screams 'scrap heap'.

steps.name: Another No-Longer-Puzzled Islander
steps.text: Good luck! Been a long time since we saw any new faces here. Hope you find who you're looking for! Oh, and enjoy your time on our island!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Thank you, sir. If you'll excuse me, then.
Sakiko places a foot lightly on the pedal—

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: As long... as this bike... can move...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: No problem!

steps.name: No-Longer-Puzzled Islander
steps.text: Careful there, you're heading straight downhill—
The warning comes a little too late. The girl and the dilapidated bike are already careening out of control as they shoot down the slope.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: AAAAAHHHHHHHH———!

steps.name: No-Longer-Puzzled Islander
steps.text: ...Now wasn't that funny?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Hahahahahah-hah-hah...

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: She really is far too funny! Hah-hahahahah!

steps.name: Wolff
steps.text: Mor—Morpheus.

steps.name: Wolff
steps.text: I... think... that was—a... bit overboard...

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Shut it.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: She's the one who agreed to this bet. I'm only abiding by our terms.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: I'll find her weak spot, I'm telling you, and once I do I'll spin her a dream from which she'll never wake.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: She'll learn...

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: I am the Castle of Dreams' most talented dreamspinner.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: ...There's no way, no way, that Iris could be better than me.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: The sun's nearly overhead, and there's not much shade under the trees...

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: It's getting rather hot now.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: My residence is close by. Why don't we go there to sit down?

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Oh—wow, it really is cooler the moment you step inside!

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: This living room is so big—it must get cold in the winter, right?

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: The house warms up very quickly if I light the fireplace. The one over there, see.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: But when I'm by myself, a little heater by the sofa is enough.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Wow, I had no idea at all you were so well-off...

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: I think you're misunderstanding something. I'm not an heiress or anything, I'm just the housekeeper here.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: (Quietly) Am I going to disturb the owner...?

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: No, don't worry. I'm the only one here right now.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: She—the owner of this place... she hasn't been back for a very long time.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: It... sounds like you really miss her.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Yes. Our relationship might be a bit more special than master and servant...

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: She was the first one to see me as I am. She was the first one to ever make friends with me.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: She loved playing the piano. I would sit next to her, and sing along.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: At first, we were happy... So very happy.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: But then, why did she leave? Why would she leave this island, her... home?

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Why indeed... Maybe, just maybe, it was only me who wanted to stay here?
The bicycle's creaking grows ever more shrill, and Sakiko's balance is increasingly precarious.
Matters aren't helped by her waning stamina.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: AHHHH—!
At a sharp turn, the bicycle flies completely out of control, and Sakiko's inertia sees her abruptly tumble away.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Guh...
She pulls her body up, gritting her teeth through the pain. With great effort, she lifts her head to look to her destination.
At the foot of a distant mountain, she sees the vague outline of a house.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: That's...
As she stares at it, countless unfamiliar memories flood into her mind out of nowhere—

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Th-that's...
In Uika's dream, Sakiko and her played there as children.
When they grew up, they lived there together.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: These... these are all part of Uika's dream?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Hmm-hmm—♪ Hmm-hm-hmm—♪

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Hm... Well, you did see it, yes? Oh, all the sweet dreams I spun for her, but this Uika girl? Her biggest wish is to be with you.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Problem. At the end of each dream, she's all alone.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: You always vanish suddenly—

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Sakiko Togawa, you're a cruel, cruel person.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I... Cruel...?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Didn't the pest give you the whole sermon?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Dreams are the truest thoughts of the heart's depths. And in the heart of Uika Misumi, well—the more she longs to be with you, the less she can touch you.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: I can weave a tiny little uninhabited isle just for the two of you, and yet all she can do is experience the pain of losing what she gains, again, and again. And again.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: This little happiness of hers is doomed to slip through her fingers like sand.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Tut, tut. What kind of heart holds such despair that even dreams can't cure it?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...Uika, I'm going to pull you out of this nightmare.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Are you really? Are you really?!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Now that's something I'd LOVE to see—the look of helpless, raging humiliation all over your face, that is!
As Morpheus cackles with wild abandon, a faraway boat sounds its horn.
The signal that it is about to return to the mainland.
